item.title: Lombard man gets probation for hate crime
item.description: <p>A Lombard man has been sentenced to probation for committing an anti-Muslim hate crime.</p><p>Larry York was sentenced Tuesday to 180 days in jail, 30 months of probation and 200 hours of community service, according to DuPage County court records.</p><p>He pleaded guilty Nov. 20 to one count of felony hate crime.</p><p>York was accused of threatening two people on Oct. 17, 2023.
